thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT CREATED — AZ1A: SNAT / conntrack table saturation detected affecting egress for inference hosts. Pager severity P1. Metric spike at 14:03 UTC. https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3614002222
ashley: seeing surge in TCP resets and 5xx from inference pool in az1a. Latency up ~40% and error rate ~6% for hosted endpoints. alert group: egress-snat-saturation
mike: confirmed. CloudWatch ENI metrics show high SNAT translations in az1a nat gateway + conntrack counters ~ close to limit on several hosts. Traces show failed downstream calls to model repo + token services.
jordan: customer impact confirmed: a handful of high-throughput customers reporting elevated errors, otherwise degraded tail latency for general traffic. Not yet wide customer outage but growing.
simone: oncall-rotation taking primary — handing off to @mike. attaching initial runbook notes.
oncall-rotation: paging @mike for mitigation. Please acknowledge.
mike: acked. I'm going to start traffic redistribution and spin up Dedicated fallback in us-east-2 for critical routes. Also lowering DNS TTL to help fast failover.
nashley: adding logs snippet — conntrack entries: ```
14:02:56 host-az1a-12 conntrack: nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet
14:03:01 host-az1a-08 conntrack: nf_conntrack: new conn failed, no space
```
jordan: what's the plan for in-flight requests? will they retry?
mike: invoke smart-routing policy: mark az1a as degraded for inference.hosted tier, shift 60% to us-east-2, 40% to eu-central for now. Command: ```sh
redwoodctl routing set-policy --route inference.hosted --degraded-az az1a --weights us-east-2=60,eu-central-1=40 --ttl 30
```
devex: heads up — lowering TTL to 30s will cause DNS churn, but OK for rapid failover. I'll prepare status note for docs and support templates.
sre-bot: autoscaling triggered for dedicated-fallback-us-east-2, requested 12 gpus. New instances provisioning.
mike: also enabling NAT gateway autoscale where possible and adding temporary SNAT pool. AWS req submitted: increase elastic-ip pool for az1a nat.
simone: I'm opening a customer comms draft. We should be careful: say degraded egress in az1a, mitigation in progress, ETA unknown.
nashley: trailing error patterns — upstream token service calls are 502, host-level retransmits. Redirecting only inference generation traffic to fallbacks, control plane stays local.
jordan: any impact to Dedicated customers pinned to az1a?
mike: yes, pinned Dedicated workloads in az1a are affected. For those with cross-az fallback enabled we'll move them, otherwise contacting account owners. Starting canary migration for two large tenants.
simone: noted. priority outreach list: Acme, Hummingbird, Nova. Simone taking lead.
oncall-rotation: mike — you're now primary. I'll move to secondary watch.
mike: started canary for Acme on us-east-2. Observing token + model pull success. If green, we'll proceed for others.
nashley: metric check: error rate down to 3.2% in routed traffic, latency p95 reduced ~20% for canary. Good sign.
jordan: what's ETA on nat pool increase and conntrack relief?
mike: EIP requests typically ~10-15min, conntrack drains slower — expecting relief in 20-30min. Meanwhile keeping routing weights shifted.
incident-bot: NOTE: incident timeline created and linked. Please update the incident doc: https://internal.redwood.ai/incidents/3614002222/doc
devex: status page updated with interim note. Support playbooks linked.
sre-bot: NAT autoscale reported partial success; some hosts still showing high conntrack due to long-lived sessions. Considering a short-term config: reduce TCP keepalive on inference proxies to free slots.
mike: good idea. Applying keepalive tweak on proxy fleet: ```sh
for host in proxy-az1a-*; do ssh $host "sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_time=60"; done
```
nashley: keepalive change applied to 20% of proxies as canary — watching for instability.
jordan: customer Acme reporting success for canary, confirms reduced errors.
simone: prepping external status update to say mitigations in place and traffic redistributed; next update in 30m.
incident-bot: oncall handoff scheduled at 14:30 UTC to @simone. Primary will remain monitoring.
mike: handing off to @simone for next shift. Leaving checklist: monitor conntrack, DNS RTT, error rate, Dedicated fallback health.
simone: taking handoff. Thanks team. I'll coordinate customer comms and keep infra actions going.
nashley: postmortem notes: probable root cause is bursty egress from model caching rebalance combined with NAT pool exhaustion. Need follow-ups: 1) conntrack table sizing + eviction policy 2) smart routing throttles per-customer 3) improve NAT pool autoscaling 4) bake keepalive tuning into proxy images.
jordan: agreed. added tasks to infra backlog.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (monitored): traffic redistributed and conntrack pressure reduced. Follow-up actions assigned. Close time 14:55 UTC.
simone: closing thread — will own postmortem and customer follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
